reviews.title: Don't think twice before buying this
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] If you think that you don't need this, then you're certainly wrong. I was also thinking so before this. The headlamp comes with the lamp, the adjustable belt and three AAA batteries so that you don't have to buy it separately. Also it's fun to install the batteries by opening the back of the lamp and then putting the lamp into the belt, the headlamp bas plastic back with cut on both sides to insert belt. The headlamp has 7 modes of light and when fully lit, it's so bright that if it falls on your eyes, you would be blinded for some moments. The red light on bottom is low battery indicator as well. It has green light mode too. I use it for dog walking at night, camping trips and to work on some DIY/tool works for home.
Haven't used it yet, got it for my boyfriend so he can use at night for cooking out on the grill
